s_szLoadingTip: You can obtain items by scanning a DigiEgg with any remaining data
You can freely enter the Digital World after you have been officially acknowledged as a member
Tip Conversations can be turned on or off from the Interface Setup in the Options window.
Mercenary Digimon are available when you get a Mercenary DigiEgg.
You can level up a skill with skill points, but check to see what you can do when you get skill points
All kinds of DigiEgg can be returned for refund.
The HP gauge can be set to be viewed in the Interface Setup in the Options window.
Chief Digimon tend to attack first, so make sure not to let yourself get surrounded by them.
You need to be an official member of Dats Center to use the D-terminal to go to the Digital World.
The default shortcut for the Digimon Information window is [ X ].
The default shortcut for the Tamer Information window is [ C ].
Tamers and Digimon have certain attractions to each other. You can check the attractions in the Tamer Information window.
The higher the attraction is to the Digimon, the more capabilities from its Tamer will be transferred to the Digimon, and this will make it stronger.
The default shortcut for the Quest Log window is [ L ].
You can set your own shortcut in Options > Shortcut Setup menu.
When the Digimon develops to level 11, Maturity Development can be applied.
Foods cannot be consumed in the middle of a battle, but just one of them before or after a battle will restore the HP of both the Digimon and the Tamer.
If you are not sure about the details of your current quest, press [ L ], the default shortcut for the Quest Log, and check what you have to do.
Basically, vaccines are weak against data, which is weak against a virus, and a virus is weak against vaccine. So make sure to check the attributes on the Target window before attacking.
You can find Mercenary DigiEgg by defeating the corresponding Digimon in the field.
[Miki] is responsible for collecting cracked DigiEggs.
You need related data items to hatch Mercenary DigiEgg. Scan DigiEgg to find the data items.
Insert data 3 times successfully to hatch a Mercenary DigiEgg. But inserting data 4 or 5 times will give you a bigger Mercenary Digimon.
Be careful when hatching a Mercenary DigiEgg because unsuccessful data insertion may destroy it.
Scan DigiEgg to get various items. For example, an HP restoring item, Tamer parts, Mercenary DigiEgg, data items to hatch the eggs, and so on.
Some items are available only by scanning DigiEgg. In particular, the data items required for hatching Mercenaries cannot be found otherwise.
The default shortcut for the Inventory window is [ I ].
Digimon use up Tamers' DS to digivolve and live on. The higher the Tamer's level is, the longer the Digimon will remain digivolved.
You can turn the Quest Notice function on or off in the Quest Log window.
Currencies are T - Tera, M- Mega and B - Bit.
Press ? to watch the tutorial video again.
Get a cracked DigiEgg, and return it to the NPC who scans and collects DigiEgg, for refund.
If your system is not up to date and you have problems with gameplay, use the "Simple Character Rendering" option under Options > Interface.
Press Ctrl + Z to hide the interface and take cooler screenshots.
Press Print Screen to take a screenshot.
While using the NPC search function,  this search function will be automatically cancelled if you use [Follow] command or if you get too far away from the Digimon you're searching for.
Pay close attention to the Tamer's Fatigue Level. Tired Tamers attack and move more slowly than usual.
Fatigue Level is active when you are in the field, but it will be restored when you are back in town.
Click the Find NPC button in the Mini Map if you don't know where an NPC is.
When the Tamer level is higher than 5 and Digimon level is higher than 11, death will mean losing XP, so be careful when you are in a battle.
The default shortcut for the Friends List window is [ F ].
Blocking will literally block all messages, including Whispers.
Cash items that are purchased on the website can be found in the Cash Warehouse in the game.
Check the Menu bar in the lower righthand corner to open the Cash Shop.
Open the Cash Shop and press "Refresh" to view what you have purchased.
There are two types of quests - a main quest and a sub-quest. You have to complete main quests in order to progress in the game.
Press Alt + click on the name of the other Tamer in the Chat window to send a Whisper directly.
If you don't know where the NPC is located, or where to go on the map, simply click on the name to view the details.
Click the icon in the lower lefthand corner to turn off the Search function.
Click on an action in a chat window to make the Tamer perform certain actions. Left click to select the action, and right click to perform it.
It is basic manners to first ask the other user's interest before a trade or a party request.
